name: Commandramon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at either the top or bottom of your deck.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effect, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon with the [D-Brigade] trait, prevent it from leaving play.
